picks.BEST_ENTERPRISE_FIT: Sportradar (production NFL package) or SportsDataIO (per-change timestamped depth charts); contract and license questions open
picks.BEST_FORWARD_ONLY_OPTION: Repository forward capture of nflverse depth/injury/roster at T24/T90 with raw hashes (already operating in the V1 shadow store; read-only reuse) plus a vendor trial in parallel
picks.BEST_LOW_COST_FIT: nflverse depth_charts_2025+ and injuries via the existing hash-captured forward snapshots (free), forward-only; upstream reuse rights for ESPN-derived rows still to be cleared
picks.BEST_PRACTICAL_FIT: Sportradar trial key as an acceptance test BEFORE any spend; SportsDataIO only after written answers on archived per-change history
picks.BEST_TECHNICAL_FIT: Sportradar (documented depth rank + injury/practice + inactives at about T-90 + Daily Change Log); unproven until a trial shows retained 2024 versions
NOT_WORTH_PURSUING: FTN full API for this gate (postgame charting)
PFF API for this gate (no documented pregame state)
Stats Perform/Opta and Genius for this gate (no documented NFL pregame state product)
Wayback scraping of NFL.com/ESPN/Ourlads (rights unresolved, sparse, names only)

providers.T24_supported: FORWARD: YES by polling at least hourly; HISTORICAL: NOT_PROVEN
providers.T90_supported: FORWARD: inactives at about T-90 with polling lag; HISTORICAL: NOT_PROVEN
providers.active_inactive: YES (inactives entered about 90 minutes before kickoff; Game Roster is game-day truth)
providers.depth_chart: YES (weekly report feed, pull on game-week cadence; may update during/after the game)
providers.historical_original_vintage: NOT_DOCUMENTED: a past-week query returns the current stored state; the docs say depth charts may update during/post game
providers.historical_start_season: Depth chart endpoint season parameter documented 2000-2026; weekly injuries 2009-2026 (OpenAPI parameter range, not a coverage claim)
providers.notes: Best documented structure for expected depth + injury + practice + inactives and a change log. A documented endpoint is not original-vintage proof: a trial test must show (a) 2024 queries return pre-kickoff states with timestamps, (b) the change log reconstructs revisions, (c) GSIS joins. Until then it cannot certify Phase1L. NO_PROVIDER_PAYLOAD_TESTED.
